title: Ines and the Bakery
author: Marguerite Dunmore
blurb: Casper Ashgrove, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
